description: This file is a shell script designed to test corner cases of 'git-archive', including handling empty trees, prefix options, empty archives, long paths, large files, and different archive formats such as tar, zip, and their variants. It includes setup routines, prerequisite checks, and multiple test cases verifying the behavior of 'git archive' under various scenarios.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and registers its removal after test completion.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Verifies the directory contents against expected file paths.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Generates a complex tree object with long paths for testing.
